# Deloitte at CES 2026

## Explore how collective insight and evolving perspectives are shaping what's next.

January 6-9, 2026 Las Vegas, NV

## Innovation loves company

Explore new possibilities for the future as we continue to work together to move industries forward. At CES 2026, participants had the opportunity to meet with our industry specialists to learn about the trends, technologies, and strategies driving change. Whether your focus is growth, transformation, or resilience, see how working with us turns possibility into practical results and helps chart a course for what’s ahead.

![](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAAAAACH5BAEKAAEALAAAAAABAAEAAAICTAEAOw==)

### Highlights from CES 2026

# C Space & Deloitte

Discover how marketing and technology leaders are shaping the future of brand and performance. Tune in to panel sessions featuring Deloitte and Mosheh Oinounou, Founder & Editor-in-Chief of Mo News, as they discuss how CMOs and Al fuel product innovation; the evolution of results-focused operations in tech, media, and telecom; and strategies for balancing short-term performance with long-term brand growth.

# FQ Lounge™ @ CES

Get to know the FQ Lounge™ @ CES—a hub where technology, creativity, and human insight converge. This year, Deloitte's China Widener and Lynne Sterrett explored how Al, design, and conscious leadership can create a more imaginative and inclusive world. Take a break from what's trending and discover truly transformative conversations.

# CES Foundry

Innovators, industry changemakers, and global leaders gathered at CES Foundry to shape what's next. Discover engaging conversations and live demonstrations exploring cutting-edge topics, from Al ethics and enterprise transformation to quantum security and decentralized finance.

# McLaren x Deloitte

Feel the power of technology engineered for speed. At CES 2026, we placed a spotlight on our work with McLaren Racing, showcasing how we help with digital twin simulations and strategic intelligence for peak performance on the track. Discover how racing-grade innovation comes to life through Deloitte's advanced modeling and decision-support capabilities.

Check out a variety of recorded Deloitte panels and sessions that took place during CES 2026. We focused on the future of technology, with in-depth discussions on emerging tech trends and practical insights into how you can set your business apart from the competition to achieve sustained growth and a powerful competitive edge.
